# Pinned Mojobox Contracts

These schema snapshots are copied unchanged from
`DSH-EAC/dsh-mojobox@13e72e1066d1d0cbf6a4d72c85d016257e7100b1`.

- `schemas/`: Mojobox Pack, PackLock and official package metadata projection schemas.
- `dsh-std/`: Mojobox's vendored Plugin Manifest 0.15 schema from
  `Yan-Zero/dsh-std@3df054302468d2091859db4b3bd079042d33f100`.
- `LICENSE`: Mojobox MIT license; `dsh-std/LICENSE`: original dsh-std license.

Local adapter extensions use `x-` fields permitted by the Plugin Manifest schema.
No upstream schema or existing Mojobox catalog record is modified.
